ex.en: She has an oval face.
ex.zh: 她有一張鵝蛋臉。

ex.en: We sat around a large oval table.
ex.zh: 我們圍坐在一張大橢圓桌旁。

ex.en: Draw an oval in the middle of the page.
ex.zh: 在頁面中間畫一個橢圓形。

ex.en: The logo is a blue oval with white letters.
ex.zh: 這個標誌是一個藍色橢圓，裡面有白色字母。

ex.en: We stayed overnight in Hakone.
ex.zh: 我們在箱根住了一晚。

ex.en: Leave the dough in the fridge overnight.
ex.zh: 把麵團放在冰箱裡過夜。

ex.en: English cannot be mastered overnight.
ex.zh: 英文不是一夜之間就能學好的。

ex.en: This saying became popular overnight.
ex.zh: 這句話一夕之間就流行起來了。

ex.en: We took an overnight train to Kaohsiung.
ex.zh: 我們搭夜車去高雄。

ex.en: Please send the package by overnight delivery.
ex.zh: 請用隔夜快遞寄送這個包裹。

ex.en: This library book is two weeks overdue.
ex.zh: 這本圖書館的書已經逾期兩週了。

ex.en: Please pay the overdue invoice immediately.
ex.zh: 請立即支付這張逾期的帳單。

ex.en: A pay raise for the staff is long overdue.
ex.zh: 員工早就該加薪了。

ex.en: The upgrade to the old system is overdue.
ex.zh: 舊系統早該升級了。

ex.en: There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房有烤箱，可以用來烤麵包。

ex.en: Did you remember to turn off the oven?
ex.zh: 你記得關烤箱了嗎？

ex.en: It is about time we bought a new microwave oven.
ex.zh: 我們該買一台新的微波爐了。

ex.en: Let me give you a brief overview of the project.
ex.zh: 讓我簡單介紹一下這個專案的概況。

ex.en: This report provides an overview of last year's sales.
ex.zh: 這份報告概述了去年的銷售狀況。

ex.en: The city should subsidize small businesses in industries with large overhead costs.
ex.zh: 市政府應該補貼固定成本高的產業中的小型企業。

ex.en: Working from home helps reduce overhead.
ex.zh: 在家工作有助於降低營運成本。

ex.en: I saw a helicopter flying overhead.
ex.zh: 我看到一架直升機從頭頂飛過。

ex.en: Birds were flying overhead.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在頭頂上飛。

ex.en: Please put your bag in the overhead bin.
ex.zh: 請把你的包包放在頭頂的置物櫃。

ex.en: Turn on the overhead light, please.
ex.zh: 請打開天花板的燈。

ex.en: This kind of mistake is easy to overlook.
ex.zh: 這種錯誤很容易被忽略。

ex.en: We have overlooked this important fact.
ex.zh: 我們忽略了這個重要的事實。

ex.en: We can't overlook the cost of shipping.
ex.zh: 我們不能忽略運費。

ex.en: The window overlooks the courtyard.
ex.zh: 窗戶正對著底下的庭院。

ex.en: Our room overlooks the sea.
ex.zh: 我們的房間可以俯瞰大海。

ex.en: The taxi driver overcharged us.
ex.zh: 計程車司機多收了我們的錢。

ex.en: I think the restaurant overcharged me.
ex.zh: 我覺得那家餐廳多算了我的錢。

ex.en: I think we overpaid for this hotel room.
ex.zh: 我覺得這間飯店房間我們付太多錢了。

ex.en: If you overpay your bill, you will get a refund.
ex.zh: 如果帳單多付了，你會收到退款。

overcrowd.zh: 使過度擁擠（常用 overcrowded 擁擠不堪的）

ex.en: The trains are overcrowded during rush hour.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段的火車擠得不得了。

ex.en: Too many tourists overcrowd the old town every summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天都有太多遊客把老城區擠得水洩不通。

ex.en: Their two shadows overlap.
ex.zh: 他們倆的影子重疊在一起。

ex.en: Our responsibilities overlap in some areas.
ex.zh: 我們的職責在某些方面有重疊。

ex.en: There is some overlap between the two projects.
ex.zh: 這兩個專案有部分重疊。

ex.en: We should avoid overlap between team members' tasks.
ex.zh: 我們應該避免團隊成員的工作重複。

overwhelm.zh: 使不知所措、使難以承受

ex.en: I didn't mean to overwhelm you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意讓你不知所措的。

ex.en: I was overwhelmed by the amount of work.
ex.zh: 工作量多到讓我喘不過氣。

ex.en: The website was overwhelmed with orders.
ex.zh: 網站被大量訂單塞爆了。

ex.en: Customer calls overwhelmed the help desk.
ex.zh: 大量客戶來電讓服務台應接不暇。

ex.en: He reprimanded me for my oversight.
ex.zh: 他責備我的疏忽。

ex.en: Due to an oversight, your order was not shipped.
ex.zh: 由於我們的疏忽，您的訂單沒有出貨。

ex.en: The committee has oversight of the budget.
ex.zh: 委員會負責監督預算。

ex.en: The project needs better oversight.
ex.zh: 這個專案需要更好的監督。

ex.en: The government plans to overhaul the tax system.
ex.zh: 政府計劃全面改革稅制。

ex.en: The engine was overhauled last month.
ex.zh: 引擎上個月徹底檢修過。

ex.en: The website needs a complete overhaul.
ex.zh: 這個網站需要全面翻新。

ex.en: The company announced a major overhaul of its pricing.
ex.zh: 公司宣布大幅調整定價方式。

ex.en: It is hard to overstate the importance of good communication.
ex.zh: 良好溝通的重要性再怎麼強調都不為過。

ex.en: The report overstated the company's profits.
ex.zh: 這份報告誇大了公司的獲利。

ex.en: There is a bridge over the river.
ex.zh: 河上有一座橋。

ex.en: The plane flew over the mountains.
ex.zh: 飛機飛越群山。

ex.en: The meeting is over.
ex.zh: 會議結束了。

ex.en: The game was over at nine.
ex.zh: 比賽九點結束。

ex.en: Over 100 people attended the event.
ex.zh: 超過一百人參加了這場活動。

ex.en: The trip cost over 30,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行花了三萬多元。

ex.en: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
ex.zh: 過去十年來，我們經歷了許多改變。

ex.en: Let's talk over a cup of tea, shall we?
ex.zh: 我們邊喝茶邊聊，好嗎？

ex.en: English is a language spoken all over the world.
ex.zh: 英語是全世界通用的語言。

ex.en: English is taught almost all over the world today.
ex.zh: 如今世界各地幾乎都在教英語。

ex.en: Overall, the movie was a success from script to screen.
ex.zh: 整體來說，這部電影從劇本到大銀幕都很成功。

ex.en: Overall, the trip was a great success.
ex.zh: 整體來說，這趟旅行很成功。

ex.en: The infrastructure of an application is directly related to its overall performance.
ex.zh: 應用程式的架構和它的整體效能直接相關。

ex.en: The overall cost of the project is two million dollars.
ex.zh: 這個專案的總成本是兩百萬元。

ex.en: He helped me to overcome the difficulties.
ex.zh: 他幫助我克服了困難。

ex.en: You have to overcome the difficulties.
ex.zh: 你必須克服困難。

ex.en: She helped him overcome his sadness.
ex.zh: 她幫助他走出悲傷。

ex.en: Do you plan to go overseas?
ex.zh: 你打算出國嗎？

ex.en: I was overseas at the time.
ex.zh: 我當時人在國外。

ex.en: His music has attained great popularity overseas.
ex.zh: 他的音樂在國外大受歡迎。

ex.en: I'd like to make an overseas call.
ex.zh: 我想打一通國際電話。

ex.en: The company is expanding into overseas markets.
ex.zh: 公司正在拓展海外市場。

ex.en: The food was good but overpriced.
ex.zh: 東西好吃，但價格太高了。

ex.en: Hotels near the station are often overpriced.
ex.zh: 車站附近的飯店常常貴得不合理。

over-the-counter.zh: 不需處方就能買的（成藥）

ex.en: You can buy this painkiller over-the-counter.
ex.zh: 這種止痛藥不需處方就能買。

ex.en: Over-the-counter cold medicine may make you sleepy.
ex.zh: 成藥類的感冒藥可能會讓人想睡。

ex.en: All of a sudden the sky became overcast.
ex.zh: 天空突然轉陰了。

ex.en: It was overcast yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天是陰天。

ex.en: I have a small overdraft on my account.
ex.zh: 我的帳戶有一點透支。

ex.en: The bank charges a fee for overdrafts.
ex.zh: 銀行會對透支收費。

ex.en: My suitcase is overweight, so I have to pay an extra fee.
ex.zh: 我的行李箱超重了，所以得付額外的費用。

ex.en: Overweight bags must be repacked before check-in.
ex.zh: 超重的行李必須在報到前重新整理。

ex.en: Sixty-nine percent of adult Americans are either overweight or obese.
ex.zh: 69%的美國成人超重或肥胖。

ex.en: I know that Tom is a little overweight.
ex.zh: 我知道湯姆有點過重。

ex.en: The flight was overbooked, so some passengers had to take a later one.
ex.zh: 這班飛機超賣了，所以有些乘客只好改搭晚一點的班機。

ex.en: Airlines sometimes offer vouchers when a flight is overbooked.
ex.zh: 航班超賣時，航空公司有時會提供抵用券。

ex.en: Use the overpass to cross the highway.
ex.zh: 請走天橋過高速公路。

ex.en: There's a bus stop under the overpass.
ex.zh: 天橋下有一個公車站。

ex.en: If you overstay your visa, you may be fined.
ex.zh: 如果簽證逾期停留，你可能會被罰款。

ex.en: He was deported for overstaying his visa.
ex.zh: 他因為簽證逾期停留而被驅逐出境。

ex.en: She oversees a team of twenty people.
ex.zh: 她督導一個二十人的團隊。

ex.en: An engineer will oversee the construction.
ex.zh: 會有一位工程師監督施工。

ex.en: The project had a cost overrun of 20%.
ex.zh: 這個專案超支了 20%。

ex.en: We need to avoid any more overruns.
ex.zh: 我們必須避免再超支。

overrun.zh: 超過（時間、預算）；侵占、蔓延

ex.en: The meeting overran by half an hour.
ex.zh: 會議超時了半小時。

ex.en: The garden was overrun with weeds.
ex.zh: 花園裡雜草叢生。

ex.en: I'm afraid you have to work overtime.
ex.zh: 恐怕你要加班了。

ex.en: I had to work overtime yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天必須加班。

ex.en: My boss made me work overtime.
ex.zh: 老闆要我加班。

ex.en: Jia-hao said he's not coming today. He has a last-minute overtime.
ex.zh: 家豪說他今天不來了，臨時要加班。

ex.en: Do you get paid for overtime?
ex.zh: 你加班有加班費嗎？
